answer: In an agent economy trading pearl jewelry and juniper oil, each seller identity must lock 100 tokens for 30 days before it can submit one offer per minute. Creating more names does not create free capacity: every added identity needs its own locked stake. A sybil swarm therefore produces a matching ripple in capital requirements; 1,000 fake sellers immobilize 100,000 tokens, imposing financing costs even if none is caught misbehaving.
